title: Not the Best Chair
text: Not the Best Chair. First and foremost this chair is not made for larger people. The arms of the chair are permanent and don't have any give to them, they also aren't able to move up and down to try and make the chair more comfortable. If you are a small person then this chair will be fine for you but if you are even a little bit small then this chair is not going to be very comfortable. However, for what it's worth it is comfortable for a short time but I wouldn't want to sit in it for a long period of time to do work. The wheels on this chair are horrible which is why I switched them out when putting this together because they would have already broken off by now if I hadn't. This chair isn't the best but there are worse ones out. Just be careful with this chair.
